description: Defines the Core::AccessControl struct with static methods for managing ownership and permissions of files or nodes, primarily for POSIX systems, using system calls like chown, chmod, getpwnam, and getgrnam.

classes.name: AccessControl
classes.description: A utility struct providing static methods for ownership and permission management of filesystem nodes.

methods.name: uint32_t OwnerShip(const string & node,const string & userName,const string & groupName)
methods.description: Sets the ownership of a node to the specified user and group, returning a status code.

methods.name: uint32_t Permission(const string & node,const uint16_t modeFlags)
methods.description: Sets permissions on a node based on mode flags, returning a status code.

methods.name: uint32_t Apply(const Core::NodeId & node)
methods.description: Applies ownership and permission settings to a node identified by NodeId.
